title: Open dual exchange sends an adjoint section to its restricted adjoint
statement:
Fix the coefficient conventions of [def-trf-coefficient-conventions], $A=A_{E,n}$ and $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$. Work in the finite-Tor constructible categories $D^b_{ctf}(-,A)$ with the canonical ordinary and exceptional adjunctions and composition comparisons of [def-trf-admissibility]. Let $C,F$ be separated finite-type $k$-schemes, $i:F\to C$ a separated finite-type morphism, and $j:W\hookrightarrow C$ an open immersion [def-weil-open-immersion]. Form the Cartesian square $F_W=F\times_CW$ with $i_W:F_W\to W$ and $j':F_W\hookrightarrow F$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Let $S\in D^b_{ctf}(F,A)$, $\sigma:A_F\to S$, and let $v:A_C\to Ri_*S$ be its ordinary $Li^*\dashv Ri_*$ adjoint, using $Li^*A_C\simeq A_F$. Let $a:A_W\xrightarrow{\sim}Rj^!A_C$ be constant pullback followed by normalized open purity [prop-functor-package]. For the canonical inverse-conjugate dual exchange $\beta_j:Rj^!Ri_*\xrightarrow{\sim}Ri_{W*}Rj'^!$ of [thm-sf-dual-base-change], the ordinary $Li_W^*\dashv Ri_{W*}$ adjoint of
$$\beta_{j,S}\circ Rj^!v\circ a:A_W\longrightarrow Ri_{W*}Rj'^!S$$
is exactly
$$A_{F_W}\simeq Lj'^*A_F\xrightarrow{Lj'^*\sigma}Lj'^*S\xrightarrow{\sim}Rj'^!S.$$
Here open purity is normalized by the extension-by-zero adjunction, and the compact-support exchange $Li^*Rj_!\simeq Rj'_!Li_W^*$ is the map whose inverse has the open-unit normalization of [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. No properness of $i,F,W$ is assumed.

source.place: §0.3(a), §1.2.2(a)-(b): ordinary adjunct of the open inverse-conjugate exchange, with the open-unit normalization expanded.
